name: fix-channel-startup
description: NOT a removal: L169 channel work clock no longer carries the requester's row startup; c.work = max(t, c.work) + transfer_service (nBL, plus write_tax for writes) instead of max(t+row_cost, c.work) + transfer_service; c.transfer unchanged (the two channel clocks now evolve identically)
header: FIX (not a removal): channel work clock advances from max(t, c.work)+transfer_service, not max(t+row_cost, c.work)
